subject: SOC 2 Type II — audit window clarification & evidence push to meet procurement deadline
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — audit window clarification & evidence push to meet procurement deadline

Team —

Quick context: Acme (Karen Cho, procurement) has a hard procurement cutover of 2026-06-10 and is blocking the PO pending a SOC 2 Type II report covering the latest audit period or a formal bridge/interim letter. They specifically asked: a) the latest Type II PDF, and b) a signed bridge letter that confirms controls since the report end date until signing.

What we know:
- Customer account: Acme Corp (DEAL-9421)
- Requested items: SOC2 Type II report (latest), signed bridge/cover letter, and confirmation of audit period cutoff
- Deadline from customer: 2026-06-10 EOD (procurement team)

Ask: can security produce a bridge letter (template attached) and confirm whether we can provide an interim statement signed by finance/legal to cover the period from 2025-12-31 (report end) -> 2026-06-10? If the auditors need to sign/acknowledge, can we loop them in for a quick confirmation?

I attached the company’s SOC2 report stub we have on file and an audit authorization form the customer returned earlier. We need:
- A short, tight bridge letter (1 page) - language vetted by legal
- A clear statement of audit period covered by the Type II we have on file
- A go/no-go by EOD today so sales can respond to procurement

Thanks — I can coordinate customer comms once we have sign-off.

— Stephanie
Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
(Attachment: SOC2_Report_TypeII_2024.pdf (stub); audit_authorization_form.pdf (stub))

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — audit window clarification & evidence push to meet procurement deadline

Thanks for the context, Stephanie. Quick answers and next steps from Security: 

1) Audit period: our latest Type II covers the period 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31. The PDF in the thread is the signed report from Clearview Audit (redacted for public-facing distribution).

2) Bridge letter: we can produce a scoped interim/bridge letter that states the controls tested through 2024-12-31 and provides a management assertion covering the period from 2025-01-01 up to the signing date. We need legal to limit new representations — i.e., no additional warranties.

3) Auditor involvement: the audit firm typically does not sign internal bridge letters, but we can ask Clearview for a brief confirmation of no material changes since the report period. I’ve copied Andrew Jones from Clearview (external) on this thread to see if he can provide a one-paragraph confirmation by Thursday. Andrew, are you available for a short acknowledgement?

Timeline proposal:
- Today (6/2): Security drafts bridge letter v1 and sends to Legal for review
- 6/3 AM: Legal returns redlines
- 6/3 PM: Finalize and route for signature (CFO/CISO signoff)
- 6/4: Send to customer; procurement has until 6/10 but they prefer earlier

I’m attaching a draft template. If Sales needs an interim sign-off statement (not legal-signed), we can do a management-signed interim while legal completes the review — but prefer to get legal sign-off prior to external delivery.

— Neha
Director, Security & Compliance
(Attachment: Bridge_Letter_Redwood_draft_v1.docx (stub))

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — audit window clarification & evidence push to meet procurement deadline

Team — appreciate the plan. To be clear on urgency: this is a ~$450k ARR initial PO and procurement will not move without the SOC2 materials. We are at the contract signature stage and procurement is explicitly tying contract signature to receipt of the Type II or an acceptable bridge.

Please prioritize. If Legal needs to triage time, happy to approve language that is limited and clearly stamped "Interim assertion pending full audit validation". If we can get a management-signed interim by EOD tomorrow that will buy us time.

Lauren — please prioritize review; if we need to escalate for an exec sign-off to get CFO signature, flag me and I’ll push on finance.

Stef — please keep Acme procurement in the loop and set expectation that we’ll deliver a signed interim by 6/3 if possible.

— Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
(Deal: DEAL-9421)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — audit window clarification & evidence push to meet procurement deadline

Thanks — I reviewed Neha’s draft and pushed a few redlines. Main legal asks:

- Limit bridge letter language to factual statements of scope and dates; avoid any expanded indemnities or warranties.
- Add a single-paragraph "limitation of reliance" that states the letter is provided solely for procurement review and not as an update to the original audit opinion.
- Require that any auditor confirmation be clearly labeled as "confirmatory" and not an amendment to the original report.

I attached a redlined version with tracked changes and a suggested short clause for the management assertion. I can be available late today for a quick sync if we need to finalize language.

— Lauren
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Bridge_Letter_Redwood_redline_v1.docx (stub))

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Andrew Jones <andrew.jones@clearviewaudit.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — audit window clarification & evidence push to meet procurement deadline

Lauren — thanks for the quick redlines, they look reasonable. I updated the draft to incorporate the limitation of reliance language and removed any language that could be construed as new warranties. 

Andrew — can you confirm whether Clearview can provide a one-paragraph statement by Thu 6/4 that says: "Clearview Audit LLP performed procedures for the period 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31 and, based on their work, has no knowledge of material control changes through 2026-06-03". We understand auditors are cautious; any brief acknowledgement would be helpful for Acme procurement.

Next steps:
- Neha: finalize bridge letter for internal signature by 6/3 AM
- Lauren: final legal sign-off during 6/3 day
- Stephanie: prep customer-facing email + DocuSign envelope once signed

— Neha
Director, Security & Compliance
(Attachment: Bridge_Letter_Redwood_draft_v2.docx (internal))

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Karen Cho <karen.cho@acme-corp.com>, procure@acme-corp.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — audit window clarification & evidence push to meet procurement deadline

Karen — thanks for the clarity on timing. We are working to get you an interim statement and the latest SOC 2 Type II PDF. Our internal timeline is: finalized signed bridge letter and management assertion by 6/3, and a copy of our signed SOC 2 Type II report to follow via DocuSign link.

If procurement needs the auditor confirmation, we’ve asked Clearview for a short confirmatory note; we will share that as soon as we receive it.

Action items for Acme: please confirm whether the one-page interim bridge letter plus the existing SOC 2 PDF is acceptable to move forward with the PO by 6/10. If you require the auditor note, please acknowledge timing constraints (we’ve requested it but external auditors control their response time).

I’ll send the signed letter and DocuSign link as soon as we have internal sign-off — aiming for 6/3.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
(Will attach: finalized Bridge letter + SOC2_Report_TypeII_2024.pdf once signed)
